_comment: Live trigger eval-set for dev-flow. Positives = production-impacting end-to-end/full-envelope work; negatives = narrow review/test/refactor requests.

queries.query: dev-flow ile production etkisi olan yeni odeme akisini spec, plan, TDD, security ve review ile uctan uca gelistir.
dev-flow skill'ini kullan: musteri-facing CSV export ayari degisikligini disciplined SDLC akisi ile bastan sona uygula.
Use dev-flow to add a backend audit-log export feature with spec, plan, tests, security review, and PR-ready diff.
Sadece bu diff icin code review yap.
